items.title: Maurice Durand Interview, 1958-08-22
items.q: Well, in Durant and Humphrey band? Mm-hmm. We had, uh, Bebe Mathis on drum. Willie, uh, Buddy Johnson, trombone, I'm playing trumpet. Willie Humphrey, clarinet.

ctx.x: Terminal Brass Band, yeah. And he gave me my first lesson. And then after that, I was taking lessons from Professor Humphrey.
No, his grandfather. His grandfather taught him.
